name: Otter
author: sachin
description: Otter.ai in the Omarchy bar: records meetings from PipeWire as they are detected -- microphone and system audio, live transcript, AI summaries, and your recent conversations. No meeting bot; nothing joins your calls.

barWidget.description: One minimal bar glyph: records meetings it detects after a countdown you can cancel, starts and stops on request, and opens your latest Otter conversations.

schema.label: Microphone
schema.description: PipeWire source to record from; empty follows the system default. Easiest set from the panel's picker (press s).

schema.label: Capture system audio
schema.description: Mix in what your speakers are playing, so the other side of a meeting is transcribed too. Turn off for a microphone-only memo.

schema.label: Show input level meter
schema.description: Show the input-level meter in the panel while recording.

schema.label: Meeting detection
schema.description: Watch for meetings (Meet, Zoom, Teams, Whereby, Jitsi, Slack huddles, Discord, plus your own patterns) and offer to record them. For always-open apps like Teams, the microphone must be in use too.

schema.label: Start and stop recording automatically
schema.description: On: record after a 5-second countdown you can cancel from the toast, and stop the same way when the meeting ends. Off: see the toasts, click to start and stop yourself.

schema.label: Extra meeting matches
schema.description: Comma-separated fragments matched against a window's app id or title, for conferencing tools not recognised by default.

schema.label: Browser holding the Otter session
schema.description: Which browser's cookies to read the Otter session from.

schema.label: Browser profile
schema.description: Profile directory name, e.g. Default or "Profile 1".
